metadata.title: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [September 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.167

context:
## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [September 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.167
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.167
- Datum: 09.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear H.M. we are going to Petropolis in two days and hope to live there quietly
for some time. Before I have thought much what you had to suffer at your
dentist as I had no less than two protheses to get - now I am
a real Englishman having my artificial teeth to take out every
evening. It was an excellent [?] dentist who really worked
wonder in making with his craftsman those two big protheses
in six days instead of six weeks and without any pain for me.
Now this is done and if Lotte would get rid of her asthma we could live
and work quietly after the long months of troubles and strain.
I have met here Manfreds brother in law. He arrives here a year ago, was
between in the United States and has the intention to stay here for the
next months, at least half a year. Last year he had still all his obli-
gations against his former boss, but he hopes as he is stabilised here
and has his permanent stay granted since November 1940 that he
will be free of his former obligations for the coming year. You cannot
imagine how it complicates his situation to be at once bound to
the new firm, the American one and the old one and he hopes that
one day he can clear his situation against the former one. He would
like to ~~take~~ rent an appartement for good - we ourselves have taken
the tiny house in Petropolis for seven months only but if it pleases
us we can take it for longer so that we have also a permanent ad-
ress and residence. It is possible that I shall give some lectures
in Argentine in spring, but we will keep meanwhile the residence;
it contains altogether 3-4 tiny rooms with a large terrace which
will be my real working room and we shall have a black servant girl
who lives near the house and if they prove as good as they are cheap we
will rejoice. Most important for me is now to finish the autobio-
graphy which is practically ready but wants revising and enlarging
and than to try to write again some short stories or a novel, some-
thing substantial and if the Balzac manuscript arrives I shall be
safe. Thanks for all dear Hannah and please use evening in Bath
as if it were yours; I hope this winter will be better than the last
one and in the great decision the odds are now on our side and
whatever happens, a world without Hitler will be a better world. Yours
Stefan
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Hotelpapier (Hotel Central, Rio de Janeiro). Der Text ist gut lesbar, die Tinte ist violett. Das Dokument weist einen Stempel des Hotels auf.

pages.notes: Scan mit Farbskala und Grauskala zur Archivierung. Der Text ist identisch mit Seite 1, jedoch durch die Skalen teilweise verdeckt.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, trotz der violetten Tinte und der Archivierungsskalen auf dem dritten Scan.
